newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to launch inflation-linked bonds end-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Greece to launch inflation-linked bonds end-Feb.

text.p: Greece will introduce inflation -linked bonds around end-February that will enhance the credibility of the government's anti-inflationary economic policy, Deputy Finance Minister Nicos Christodoulakis told reporters.
"We will introduce inflation-linked bonds around end-February," said Christodoulakis who added that he expected insurance firms and pension funds to be among the fans of the new instrument.
The maturity of the CPI index-linked bonds and their real interest will be determined before they hit the market, he said.
